title: Junior DevOps & Linux Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Administer and maintain Linux-based physical and virtual servers in on-premises data centers. Monitor server health, storage, networking, and infrastructure performance. Troubleshoot Linux OS, application, database, and network-related issues. Support virtualization platforms and server provisioning. Manage and support AWS cloud resources and hybrid infrastructure. Configure and maintain Apache, Nginx, HAProxy, MySQL, Redis, and other application services. Assist with Docker deployments and CI/CD pipelines. Develop shell scripts to automate routine infrastructure operations. Support server patching, security hardening, backups, and disaster recovery. Work closely with senior engineers and development teams to maintain reliable production environments. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 02 years of experience in Linux administration, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, or data center operations. Freshers with strong Linux skills, hands-on projects, or home lab experience are encouraged to apply. AWS certifications are highly preferred. Knowledge of physical server administration and virtualization is a significant advantage. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Willingness to learn and work with both traditional data center infrastructure and modern cloud technologies. 
 Perks and benefits 
 Industry standard Perks & Benefits provided.

Key Skills: Docker,Linux System Administration,EKS,MySQL Cluster,ECS,Nginx,Database Administration,Vpc
